interactions.limitations: Automation only. No form submission, publication or external message. Narrow-viewport reflow does not replace native browser zoom, human assistive technology or physical devices. CSS zoom was rejected as a proxy because it does not trigger viewport media queries.

mediaMotion.scope: Local compiled image and motion regression guards adopted for C6; not a field-performance certificate. Initial visible images only; 200KB each, selected width <=1.5x displayed device pixels with 640px floor, timed entrance <=1s once, native scroll timelines separate; reuse of an already loaded larger visible image is exempt from width guard, reduced motion static.

nativeZoom.method: Chrome native default page zoom in disposable profiles; authenticated incognito contexts only. CSS zoom=1, visualViewport.scale=1; CSS width and DPR prove 100/200/400 percent. This is browser automation, not human/physical-device use.

assistantContrast.method: Assistant contrast review aid: raster-sampled background under text rectangles with foreground/ancestor alpha compositing, 2px grid. Includes gradients and images. Current rendered states only; native controls and non-text shapes require separate judgment. Screenshot text paint hidden in memory; customer strings/HTML never recorded.
